summary: Cameco filed a Form 6-K to report that its Cigar Lake mine in Saskatchewan has resumed production after a temporary suspension due to challenges at Orano's McClean Lake mill. The mine has begun shipping stockpiled ore and restarted production. The company's 2026 production outlook for Cigar Lake remains unchanged at 17.5-18.0 million pounds U3O8 (100% basis). This is an operational update regarding production resumption, not a special situation transaction. There are no deal terms, no board actions, no third-party advisors, and no structural changes. This is a routine operating update with no special-situation event.
